en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid Al-Barqi, from Abān Al-Aḥmar, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain Al-Khazzāz, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, who said:

We were with Abī ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) and we mentioned Ḥusain (a.s.) – May Allāh’s curse be upon his killers. Abū ‘Abdillāh (a.s.) started to cry and we cried with him. Then he raised his head and said, “Ḥusain (a.s.) said, ‘I am the Martyr of Tears. No believer remembers me without crying.”
